history.headline: Aerobic efficiency gain is now confirmed by HR data — easy-run HR has dropped meaningfully on comparable efforts.
watch_items: Watch whether the easy-run HR improvement continues to hold as weekly volume stays elevated — a plateau here would be informative.
Monitor strength session frequency over the coming weeks to catch any further drift while running load is high.
Zone 2 volume is sitting well below the target range — worth noticing whether this is a structural gap or a consequence of how sessions are being distributed.
Sleep data is too sparse to draw conclusions yet, but as tracking accumulates, watch for any pattern between low-score nights and next-day aerobic HR.
